lines.text: Commander. The northern front is yours.
Build your base. Harvest the ore. Keep the power running.
Send in tanks, rockets and artillery, and take the crossing.
Five fronts, from the Iron Pass to the Nordlys Valley.
Bring up to seven friends, or hold the fjord alone.
And the war keeps going, even after you close your browser.
Noordheim. Free, in your browser. Deploy now.

music.title: Northern Front
music.prompt: Epic cinematic trailer score for a Nordic Cold War strategy game. 0-10s: icy wind, a lone Hardanger fiddle melody over a low cello drone. 10-24s: steady military snare and deep taiko drums enter, low strings pulse. 24-46s: brass and wordless male choir build with rising tension, driving ostinato strings. 46-56s: full orchestral climax with big percussion hits. 56-64s: one final massive hit, then a ringing, hopeful resolve on the fiddle and fade to silence. Instrumental, no vocals, no lyrics.
